paywall.title: Subscriptions
paywall.pending: The purchase is awaiting approval. The subscription activates on its own as soon as the payment is confirmed.
paywall.purchaseError: We couldn't activate the subscription. Please try again.
paywall.storeUnavailable: We couldn't reach the store, so subscriptions can't be purchased right now. Check your connection and try again.
paywall.missingPlans: Some plans are not available in the store at the moment. Please try again later.
paywall.unavailableNote: Unavailable in the store at the moment.
paywall.restoreEmpty: We found no purchases to restore on this account.
paywall.restoreError: We couldn't restore your purchases. Please try again.
paywall.renewNote: The subscription renews automatically each month at the displayed price, unless you cancel it at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel it anytime from your account settings.

iap.unavailable: The store isn’t available on this device. Check your connection and your App Store account.
iap.productMissing: This plan isn’t available in the store right now. Try later or pick another one.
iap.notConfirmed: The store recorded the payment, but we couldn’t activate the subscription just now. You won’t be charged again — we’ll finish the activation automatically when you come back.
iap.alreadyOwned: You already have this subscription. Tap “Restore purchases” to bring it back to this device.
iap.noReceipt: The store didn’t return proof of payment. Try the purchase again.
iap.inProgress: A purchase is already in progress. Wait for it to finish.
iap.unknown: Couldn’t complete the purchase. Try again.
